reasons.requirements: The spec and diff cover all seven acceptance criteria, including the edge cases of removal via null, leap days, a todo due today, and a done todo.
reasons.scope: The change stays within the ticket; the only extras are the spec and plan docs and a small whitespace-separation test.
reasons.tests: The tests are thorough and use a fake clock, and the one existing assertion was only extended for the new fields. The filter toggle is not tested outside the manual end-to-end run.
reasons.conventions: The change follows AGENTS.md: ValidationException from the store, no new packages, data-testid on new elements, and tests written alongside the code.
reasons.architecture: Validation and the overdue rule live only in TodoStore; the API and page reuse it, and Program.cs changes by a single line.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and the null-versus-absent PATCH handling is sound. The TodoPatch backing-field trick is slightly clever and Overdue is computed on every read, but both are acceptable.
